item.title: LLM VRAM Estimator
item.description: Enter a Hugging Face model ID to estimate its GPU VRAM requirements. The estimator fetches the model config directly from HuggingFace and computes weight memory, KV cache, activations, and training overhead — entirely in your browser, no data is sent anywhere.
